question: The loop's canonical execution (we_) is ended right after the approve flip (dev_loop.py ~:4160), before the implement submit, and mctl-api only mints run tokens for non-terminal executions. Which execution should the DevLoop implement run's execution_id name?
reason: Copying the investigate source into implement_params as the issue specifies would hand the implementer an already-terminal we_, so the S5 observe proof would most likely still show a refused exchange. The proposal defaults to option (a); the choice changes when the work item accepts new execution requests.

options: (a) Same canonical we_, kept non-terminal until the implement run finishes (proposal default)
(b) Same canonical we_, still ended at the flip; accept whatever the exchange answers in observe
(c) A new execution attached to the same WorkItem for the implement run
